scope: Existing validation artifacts only; no test split or images loaded. Used for bottleneck diagnosis, not threshold or target tuning.
severity_measure: input-reference mean absolute RGB error from the frozen V6 validation diagnostic
pareto_dominance: Candidate A dominates B iff A is <= B on all three objectives and strictly < on at least one. Exact ties do not dominate.
decision: CASE A: SELECTOR BOTTLENECK. Non-aggressive candidates are Pareto-optimal frequently across all severity quartiles; do not redesign candidate generator. Keep V4 generator architecture and build an explicitly condition-aware selector.

training_only_rank_target_audit.target_formula: For each training image, rank the three V4-best candidates separately by reference L1, preservation distortion, and consequence L1. Lower is better; ties share average rank. Divide each rank by 2, average the three dimensions with equal 1/3 weight, and select the minimum mean-rank candidate. Targets are not forced or balanced.
training_only_rank_target_audit.targeting_note: This is a training-only descriptive audit on V4 candidate metrics from the existing Phase A cache. Validation Pareto results were not used to choose target formula or class frequencies.
